title: Review class delivery state
intro: Review the grading state and the evidence before applying or delivering grades.

steps.review: Delivery enabled is policy; the stage reports comparison with student workspace receipts. Canvas verification is separate.
steps.verify: Compare a graded activity with its receipt. It should say delivered only when the current score and denominator match, and an unreadable receipt should remain unverified.
steps.say: Delivery enabled is policy; the stage reports comparison with student workspace receipts. Canvas verification is separate.
